author: V. I. Hancock
title: Clara H. Carlson School enrolled 19 multiracial students for 2025-26
text:
Clara H. Carlson School had 19 multiracial students during the 2025-26 academic year, reflecting a 5% decrease from the prior year, figures from the New York State Education Department show.
The school reported a total enrollment of 736 students for 2025-26. Within this group, multiracial students accounted for 2.6% of the population, making them the third least represented ethnic group at the school.
The school is situated within the Elmont Union Free School District, whose main office is based in Elmont.
Compared to the other five schools in the district, Clara H. Carlson School reported the largest number of multiracial students at that time.
World Population Review’s analysis found that New York’s public education system held the nation’s No. 2 ranking overall but ranked 31st for K-12 performance.
